text: This report recommends approval of a Rental Housing Demolition application which proposes to demolish 7 rental dwelling units located at 6 and 8 Earl street. Two rental units were demolished without a permit in 2024. The 7 existing rental units and 2 previously demolished units are proposed to be replaced as 9 new rental dwelling units part of the new development on the site. The proposal includes a Tenant Assistance Plan that addresses the right of existing tenants to return to replacement rental units at similar rents and provides financial compensation to mitigate hardship. The proposed development on the site at 5 Huntley Street and 2-8 Earl Street and a portion of 10 Earl Street is the subject of a related Official Plan and Zoning By-law Amendment application (24 140234 STE 13 OZ).
